description: Cleaner worker: task outcomes, deletion throughput, per-zoom resolutions and latency

panels.title: Tasks in progress
panels.description: Tasks currently being executed

panels.title: Completed
panels.description: Task attempts acked in the selected range

targets.expr: sum(increase(cleaner_tasks_total{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", job_type=~"$job_type", task_type=~"$task_type", strategy=~"$strategy", status="completed"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Task attempts rejected without retry in the selected range

targets.expr: sum(increase(cleaner_tasks_total{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", job_type=~"$job_type", task_type=~"$task_type", strategy=~"$strategy", status="failed"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Retried
panels.description: Task attempts rejected with retry (task returns to Pending) in the selected range

targets.expr: sum(increase(cleaner_tasks_total{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", job_type=~"$job_type", task_type=~"$task_type", strategy=~"$strategy", status="retried"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: completed / (completed + failed) in the selected range; retries are excluded since the task is attempted again

targets.expr: sum(increase(cleaner_tasks_total{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", job_type=~"$job_type", task_type=~"$task_type", strategy=~"$strategy", status="completed"}[$__range])) / (sum(increase(cleaner_tasks_total{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", job_type=~"$job_type", task_type=~"$task_type", strategy=~"$strategy", status=~"completed|failed"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Objects deleted
panels.description: Tiles / keys / objects deleted in the selected range (FS stored-resources deletion counts paths)

panels.title: Deleted / sec
panels.description: Deletion throughput by strategy and storage provider. FS stored-resources deletion removes whole directories, so that series is paths/sec, not tiles/sec.

targets.expr: sum by (strategy, storage_provider) (rate(cleaner_objects_deleted_total{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", strategy=~"$strategy", storage_provider=~"$storage_provider"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failed / sec
panels.description: Failed deletions by bounded reason (raw reasons are in the logs)

panels.title: Tiles deleted / sec per zoom
panels.description: Stacked per-zoom deletion throughput of the tiles-deletion strategy

targets.expr: sum by (zoom) (rate(cleaner_tiles_deleted_by_zoom_total{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", storage_provider=~"$storage_provider", zoom=~"$zoom"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tiles deleted per zoom (range)
panels.description: Total tiles deleted per zoom level in the selected range

targets.expr: sum by (zoom) (increase(cleaner_tiles_deleted_by_zoom_total{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", storage_provider=~"$storage_provider", zoom=~"$zoom"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Task duration
panels.description: Task attempt duration (dequeue to ack/reject) by strategy

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, strategy) (rate(cleaner_task_duration_seconds_bucket{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", job_type=~"$job_type", task_type=~"$task_type", strategy=~"$strategy"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, strategy) (rate(cleaner_task_duration_seconds_bucket{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", job_type=~"$job_type", task_type=~"$task_type", strategy=~"$strategy"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Batch delete duration
panels.description: Duration of a single tiles-deletion batch delete call by storage provider

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, storage_provider) (rate(cleaner_delete_batch_duration_seconds_bucket{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", storage_provider=~"$storage_provider"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, storage_provider) (rate(cleaner_delete_batch_duration_seconds_bucket{app="cleaner", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance", storage_provider=~"$storage_provider"}[$__rate_interval])))
